name: LAN_FPS
notes: Next Gen online update: Orbit Crown, a seeded tiny-planet arena; four new low-poly operatives (Rico, Dante, Lucia, Nina) on one shared rig, holding their weapons in third person; appearance creator (outfits, skin tones, Matte/Neon Rim shaders, accents) that every player sees; new authored stylised weapon models with glowing tracers and muzzle light; Control and Capture the Flag modes; modern combat HUD. Fixes: grenades now visibly fly, guests render and load the host map, remote avatars animate, effect memory leaks.
